english: As we read, in the confession of the holy Trinity, Father, Son and Holy Spirit, the true God,
we begin to write the book of the Chronography of the sons of men,
which was composed by Mar Gregory the Maphrian,
the light of the East and of the West,
that is, Abu'l-Faraj son of Aaron, the physician, of the city of Melitene,
and who is called Bar 'Ebraya (Barhebraeus).
First, the prayer.
O God, help my weakness.
Blessed are You, Lord and Master of every beginning and commencement.
You are the First and You are the Last.
To You every praise is fitting,
and to You every thanksgiving is due.
To the Son, the Word, the power of Your wisdom,
and to the Holy Spirit, the life of Your being,
from eternity, now, and for ever.
And because this discourse was created to make known the truth of life, so that You may be praised for it and that the good in it may be found,
and for the knowledge, from that first of the theoretical reflections,
and for this second, from the more practical teachings:
the records of the histories of the times, in every generation, the good and the wicked, have served;
it is of no small benefit to all those who are eager to acquire what is good,
and who avoid and hate what is evil,
while to the advantages of the first, to test the vessel's {OCR?} sweetness {OCR?},
and to the second's diligence, to spur on speed {OCR?}.
